title: NBN POI 3HAW (Hawthorn) NNI Rehoming
current_summary: Planned maintenance will occur at the NBN Hawthorn (3HAW) POI in Melbourne on Tuesday 8 September 2026 between 12:00 AM and 2:00 AM AEST. NBN services served by this POI may be disrupted during the window (up to 2 hours) while services are moved to new network equipment. Services should restore automatically after the window.

updates.content:
We will be performing planned maintenance affecting some NBN services served by the Hawthorn (3HAW) POI in Melbourne.

When:
Tuesday 8 September 2026, 12:00 AM–2:00 AM AEST.

What you may experience:
- Interruption to NBN connectivity during the window (up to 2 hours).
- Brief dropouts as services are moved to new network equipment.

What we’re doing:
Our team will rehome services at this POI to improve network capacity and resilience. We’ll work to keep any interruption as short as possible.

What you can do:
No action is needed. Services should restore automatically after the window. If your service remains offline after 2:00 AM, please restart your modem/router. If issues persist, contact our support team.
